answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as an empty meadow: open ground nothing has been planted in yet. Standing is cultivated across many epochs, each attested contribution a furrow in the soil. Over time the record becomes an atlas of proven tenure, wide enough to consult, and it holds like permafrost across a tundra of turnover. Because voting weight follows witnessed tenure, synthetic meadows stay bare.
